clause_text_en:
4. Mobile Post offices  –  Mobile Post Offices are functioning at Bomba y, 
Calcutta, Delhi, Madras, Ahmedabad, Nagpur, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kanpur, Poona, 
Jaipur and Bhilai Industrial Township.  These Mobile Post Offices are intended to 
provide the facility of late posting in the different areas of the cities at different tim ings 
according to a fixed schedule (excluding insured and V.P.).  “These offices remain closed 
on Sundays and Postal Holidays.”  The Mobile Post Offices sell stamps and Postal 
stationery, grant certificate of posting, book surface and air mail registered a rticles of the 
letter mail (excluding insured and V.P.) and air parcels besides accepting unregistered 
articles of the letter mail for dispatch.  The mobile Post Offices at Madras and Nagpur are 
also permitted to book money orders.
